title: Annealed multi-hypothesis next-item prediction
setting: Synthetic catalogue of 64 items with 2-d latent embeddings in 8 regions. A history is 3 items from one region, and the next item is drawn from a uniform mixture over K_true target regions determined by the source region, with popularity skew inside each region. A one-hidden-layer MLP outputs H softmax score vectors over the catalogue and trains for 300 full-batch Adam steps. The metric is Recall@5 of the true next item on 1000 fresh held-out sequences, ranking items by the max over hypotheses.

paper.title: Compote: Collapse-Resistant Multiple Hypothesis Learning For Sequential Recommendation
paper.claim: Multi-hypothesis training with an annealed uniform-to-winner-takes-all objective avoids head collapse and ranks the true next item better than single-head and conventional multi-head training when the next item is ambiguous.

metric.name: recall5
metric.description: Recall@5 of the sampled next item on held-out histories, using max-over-hypotheses item scores. Diagnostics: recall10, recall5_pooled (mean-pooled scores), active_heads (hypotheses winning at least 5% of training samples), and win_entropy (entropy of the training win distribution).

factors.name: method
factors.description: single: one head with a wider hidden layer to match parameters; uniform: H heads with averaged per-head loss; wta: H heads with hard winner-takes-all from step 0; compote: H heads with softmax-weighted loss annealed from uniform to hard WTA over the first 70% of steps.

factors.name: k_true
factors.description: Number of target regions in the next-item mixture, i.e. the ambiguity of the conditional distribution (1 is unimodal).

factors.name: n_hyp
factors.description: Number of hypothesis heads H, which also sets the parameter budget the single-head model matches.
